data.title: D · 蜜月露台的晚礼服凝睇
data.description: 伪装成蜜月度假的高级海景套房阳台，夜幕下一片宁静。D身着一袭优雅性感的黑色深V丝绸晚礼服，倚靠在雕花铁艺栏杆旁。夜风吹拂起她鬓边的发丝，平日里隐藏杀机的眼眸此刻倒映着海面碎浪与星辉，神情优雅从容，透出假戏真做般的深切眷恋。
data.location: high-rise hotel suite balcony at midnight
data.action: leaning against wrought iron balcony railing under starry night sky, backless black evening gown, wind fluttering brown hair, looking at viewer with calm alluring gaze
data.lighting: soft starlight and warm balcony wall sconce illumination
data.mood: glamorous covert romance, lingering dangerous intimacy
data.promptProse: Resting on a luxury hotel balcony under a starry night sky, D wears an elegant black silk evening gown. The ocean breeze plays with her brown locks as she gazes back with calm, understated devotion.
data.animaCaption: D standing on a night balcony in an elegant black gown, looking back with serene affection.
